DeWalt DCG407N-XJ 18V XR cordless angle grinder is engineered for efficient metal cutting and material removal. The 125mm (5") blade diameter allows use in a variety of applications, and the robust, brushless, air-cooled motor ensures enhanced durability and efficiency, making it a reliable tool for electricians and fabricators on demanding jobsites. An electronic clutch reduces kickback reaction in case of a pinch or stall, while mesh debris covers restrict dust ingress into the motor, promoting jobsite safety and tool longevity. 125mm (5") Blade Diameter for Versatile UseThe design includes a removable cutting guard and an on/off slider switch for user convenience and operational safety. A rubber over-mould and 2-position handle provide comfort and control during extended use. Supplied with a Hex key wrench (Allen key) for disc changing. Compatible with DeWalt 18V XR battery technology (battery sold separately).
